top_signals.title: Taxing high earners to help fund Social Security gains bipartisan attention — what it could mean for benefits
top_signals.summary: With Social Security due to reach a funding shortfall in six years, more lawmakers are opening up to the idea of taxing high earners to help fund the program.

top_signals.title: LIV Golf’s $5 Billion Path to Bankruptcy
top_signals.summary: LIV shook professional golf with flashy tournaments and big payouts, thanks to billions of dollars in backing from the Saudi sovereign wealth fund. On today’s Big Take podcast, David Gura and Golf.com senior writer Sean Zak look at why LIV Golf couldn’t make the cut — and how it changed pro golf. Listen wherever you get your podcasts.  (Source: Bloomberg)
